why: Image 2 has warm, hazy street-lamp light that also falls on the brick facades and the paving, and the canal reflections are broken up by the water, so it reads as a real Amsterdam quay at night. Image 1 lights the quay with a hard white theatrical spot ending in a crisp circle, and its clean grey paving and flat, unlit facade make it look like a staged CG scene, not a photograph of a real place.
